HexKagune 6.0.3 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server.

**Fixed in 6.0.3**
- Kaneki's menu shows only his five mutations (Reach & Control, Auto Projectile, Centipede Body, Projectile Reflex Organ, Full Kakuja: Hunter), one per tier. The ten cut mutations are gone from it entirely.
- Everything from 6.0.2: the Steel Blade trails low behind Ayato instead of a T-pose, the half mask fits the face, Kaneki's kakugan stays on his face while transforming, his idle stance works with 3D Skin Layers, and the Appearance & Abilities button is gone.
- 6.0.3 works with any 6.0 server and players.
